name: The Fate of the Den

angles.text: As a druid, you feel the weight of this tragedy. Those who fell were your fellows, and hostile cultists betrayed their secluded refuge.

faq.answer: Lotheluum lives in Valanaar and receives reports about the druid den. News of the assault and the recovered missive grieve him for his fallen fellows, so he takes evidence of betrayal to the High Elder.

Cultists devastated the druid den and killed many defenders. An adventurer helped bring the immediate danger under control, and the battered survivors found evidence that an insider had guided the attack.
faq.q: What happened at the druid den?

faq.answer: The missive reveals that someone hidden in Valanaar has secretly fed intelligence to the cult. It suggests local sabotage and espionage enabled the deadly raid on the den.
faq.q: What does the recovered missive reveal?

faq.answer: The High Elder is an authority in Valanaar to whom Lotheluum answers. Facing heavy casualties and the threat of a traitor, Lotheluum brings the missive and news of the tragedy to the High Elder.
faq.q: Who is the High Elder mentioned by Lotheluum?

faq.answer: Members of a cult operating in the region attacked the druid den. An informant sheltered in Valanaar guided them, and the assault cost the den's inhabitants dearly.
faq.q: Who was responsible for attacking the druid den?

aliases: why do we deliver the missive
why cant the survivor go to valanaar
faq.answer: The survivor was too badly wounded by the attack to make the trek to Valanaar. The survivor stayed behind to eliminate remaining cultists and sent an adventurer to raise the alarm.
faq.q: Why could the survivor at the den not deliver the missive personally?

sections.body: Cultists struck the druid den and left its defenders battered and grieving for fallen comrades. Outside aid brought the immediate danger under control, but the physical and emotional devastation remains immense. The dead cannot be brought back, and the wounded survivors are too weak for the long trek. Lingering cultists still roam nearby.
sections.title: Tragedy at the Den

sections.body: The recovered missive shows the cultists chose their target with purpose. Someone hidden within Valanaar has been feeding them intelligence. When Lotheluum hears of the slaughter and reads the dispatch, grief for his fallen fellows gives way to alarm. A traitor still walks free in the settlement. He takes the evidence to the High Elder so their sacrifice will not be forgotten.
sections.title: Treachery in Valanaar

summary: At the druid den, survivors mourn their fallen after the cultist assault. The Fate of the Den reaches Lotheluum in Valanaar with a recovered missive and word of heavy losses. The dispatch reveals that someone in Valanaar has been feeding vital information to the enemy.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Fate of the Den
